title: TCA-Nexus Linker: an elicitation instrument for linking IPBES transformative-change actions to Nexus response options
description:
Web application used by IPBES experts to link the 22 transformative-change actions of the IPBES Transformative Change Assessment (chapter 5) to the 71 response options of the IPBES Nexus Assessment (chapter 5).

The application is an elicitation instrument rather than an inference tool: it proposes no candidate matches, ranks nothing and computes no textual similarity, so every recorded link is an explicit judgement made by a named expert. Judgements are attributed, qualified as primary or secondary, never merged, and exported in structured form for analysis.

This release also contains the generator for the publication figures drawn from those judgements.
